comments.rulesWelcome: Reviews, suggestions and change requests are all welcome, and so is talking markets. Speak freely.

prediction.title: BTC 5-minute prediction
prediction.targetTip: BTC reference price when the round opened. Above it at the close is up, below is down.
prediction.upTip: Probability price: 50¢ = the market gives a 50% chance of going up. Higher price, stronger conviction.
prediction.downTip: Probability price: 50¢ = the market gives a 50% chance of going down. Higher price, stronger conviction.
prediction.estPayoutTip: Right prediction: every contract settles at $1. Payout = amount ÷ probability price.
prediction.estProceedsTip: What you receive at the current sell price, after fees.
prediction.mySharesTip: Contracts you hold; each is worth $1 if the prediction is right.
